name: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Quiver
summary: A faded Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Quiver asks you to bring one Heavy Quiver to a marked location and gives payment details.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The note asks you to acquire one Heavy Quiver and bring it to the place marked on your map. Keep the writ with you to complete the exchange.

faq.answer: The customer requests one Heavy Quiver.
The delivery place is marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. Carry the writ with you to complete the exchange.

faq.q: Can I give this writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ can be transferred to someone else.
The writ gives payment details, but no amount is stated.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Quiver
